verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge documents that knowledge is stored in the user's own configured storage provider, so users choose the backing store and therefore where the data lives. Region or residency is never addressed directly, and the actual location depends on wherever that provider is deployed. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection documentation, data-residency guarantees or compliance statements, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Knowledge is stored in your configured storage provider, which adds its own `mastra_knowledge_*` tables the first time Knowledge is used
